scoring_settings._comment_offense: 25 yds/pt = 0.04, 10 yds/pt = 0.1. No 'rec' key = standard (non-PPR), matching the table (no Receptions row).
scoring_settings._comment_kickers: Field goals made, by distance bucket. Sleeper does not break out missed FGs by distance for scoring purposes.
scoring_settings._comment_dst: Defense/Special Teams. pts_allow_* are pre-bucketed flags Sleeper provides (1 if that bracket applies that week, else 0), so they work as plain weights just like everything else.

notifications._comment: Do NOT put a real bot token here. Set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID as GitHub repo secrets instead -- see README.md. batch_threshold: number of simultaneous breakouts needed before they're combined into one message (default 3) -- fewer than that get sent as separate pings.

roster_management._comment: Set enabled true once Yahoo OAuth is set up (see README.md). Only suggests adds into an already-open bench/IR spot -- never suggests a drop. League/team keys are NOT stored here -- set them as GitHub secrets YAHOO_NFL_LEAGUE_KEY, YAHOO_NFL_TEAM_KEY, YAHOO_NBA_LEAGUE_KEY, YAHOO_NBA_TEAM_KEY instead, so the repo doesn't reveal which league/team you're in.

check_interval_notes: Actual check frequency is controlled by the GitHub Actions cron schedule, not this file. See .github/workflows/fantasy_alerts.yml

scheduling._comment: extra_nfl_game_dates: manual override for NFL game days that don't fall on the usual Thu/Sun/Mon (+Sat in weeks 15+), e.g. a Christmas Day game. Format: ['2026-12-25']. NBA doesn't need an override -- it's checked against real Sleeper data, not a day-of-week guess.

health_check._comment: failure_alert_threshold: consecutive failures before sending one Telegram alert (~30 min at threshold 6 on a 5-min interval). yahoo_breaker_threshold: consecutive Yahoo failures before pausing retries. yahoo_breaker_cooldown_minutes: how long that pause lasts.

tier_check._comment: Backs the /check <position> Telegram command (NFL only). Pulls STD-scoring tier lists from fantasyfootballtiers.com and cross-references against your Yahoo league's available players. cache_hours: how long a fetched tier list is reused before re-fetching (the site updates periodically, not every few minutes, so this avoids hammering it on every command).
